name: Geilo

seo.title: Geilo ski resort guide
seo.description: A ski village at 800 metres with its own station on the Oslo-Bergen railway, a November to April season and floodlit evening skiing twice a week.
seo.twitterDescription: 800 m up, on the Bergen railway, with floodlit evenings twice a week.
seo.webpageDescription: Ski facts, season, where to stay and how to get to Geilo in Buskerud, Norway.

h1: Geilo ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Geilo sits at 800 metres on the Oslo-Bergen railway, which makes it one of the few Norwegian ski villages you can reach without a car. The season runs from November to April, the slopes are floodlit on Tuesdays and Fridays, and the cross-country tracks at the stadium open in late October.
stayOverview: Geilo is a village either side of a railway line, with the slopes above it. A bed in the village means the station is on foot; a bed at the lifts means the first run is.
hotelIntro: Book against the season: November to April, with the floodlit evenings on Tuesdays and Fridays.
rentalCars: Geilo has its own station on the Oslo-Bergen line, so this is one of the few Norwegian ski resorts where a car is genuinely optional.
